story: Omar and Nina visit a large shop on the weekend. They look for a white sweater for Nina's mother. They find a different sweater that is free. They plan to keep it for a year. Before they go home, they play in the pool for one hour. They think about their happy future.
title: A Weekend Trip
setting: A large shopping mall and a swimming pool.

characters.name: Omar
characters.look: A young boy with short black hair and a blue t-shirt.

characters.name: Nina
characters.look: A young girl with long brown hair and a yellow dress.

characters.name: Mother
characters.look: A woman with glasses and a green coat.

sentences.en: Omar and Nina visit a large shop.
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar, a boy with short black hair, and Nina, a girl with long brown hair, walk into a large shop.

sentences.en: They enjoy this fun weekend activity.
sentences.zh: 他们很享受这个有趣的周末活动。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar and Nina are smiling and walking through a bright shop.

sentences.en: They want a white sweater for mother.
sentences.zh: 他们想为妈妈买一件白色的毛衣。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar and Nina look at a white sweater on a hanger.

sentences.en: The sweater is different and very nice.
sentences.zh: 这件毛衣很不一样，非常好看。
sentences.scene_prompt: Nina holds up a different colored sweater next to the white one.

sentences.en: This special sweater is free today.
sentences.zh: 这件特别的毛衣今天是免费的。
sentences.scene_prompt: A sign on the sweater says it is free.

sentences.en: They will keep it for a year.
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar and Nina hold the white sweater carefully.

sentences.en: Before they go home, they play.
sentences.zh: 在回家之前，他们去玩耍。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar and Nina are running toward a swimming pool.

sentences.en: They swim in the pool one hour.
sentences.zh: 他们在游泳池里游了一个小时。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar and Nina are swimming in a large blue swimming pool.

sentences.en: They think about their happy future.
sentences.zh: 他们思考着他们幸福的未来。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar and Nina sit by the pool and look at the bright sky.
